project_name: Vametra AI - Homepage Redesign & Scroll-Driven Motion System
design_archetype: Archetype 2: The Performance Pro + Old Money Tech (Obsidian Navy #050816, Electric Cyan #00C2FF, Imperial Violet #7C3AED)
instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the user directive: Just change the design, layout, styling, and animation; DO NOT alter any backend API, routing, search logic, query handlers, or existing data-testid attributes.

Ensure all existing data-testid tags remain present and attached to their corresponding elements: home-eyebrow, home-hero-title, home-search-input, home-search-submit, home-search-result-N, home-features-label, feat-customs, feat-brain, feat-expo, feat-news, home-command-center, home-command-center-cta, home-verified-buyers, home-buyers-cta, home-services-highlight, home-services-cta, india-label, india-feature-N, story-label, story-cta-explore, story-cta-expos, download.
Use framer-motion (already in package.json at v11.18.0) using useScroll and useTransform for smooth GPU-accelerated scroll-driven animations (transform, opacity, scale, filter).
Add prefers-reduced-motion hooks / CSS fallbacks to guarantee zero layout breakage or vestibular issues for motion-sensitive users.

Ensure total mobile responsiveness (390px viewport check): the 3D globe must NOT eat the mobile viewport, search input must be accessible, typography must obey max scale (text-4xl on mobile, text-6xl on desktop).

candidate_headlines.h1_jsx:
Rule Global Trade.
Before Cargo Moves.
candidate_headlines.sub_copy: Instant landed-cost waterfalls, real-time customs duty, sanctions-screened verified buyers, and AI regulatory clearance across 195+ sovereign markets — from your command console.
candidate_headlines.rationale: High-velocity, authoritative, and outcome-oriented. Instead of passive infrastructure ('desk re-engineered'), it positions the exporter/importer as the master of international trade with immediate predictive edge before container dispatch.

candidate_headlines.h1_jsx:
Every Border Cleared.
Every Buyer Verified.
candidate_headlines.sub_copy: Decode HS codes, unlock bilateral FTA margins, screen international counterparties against live sanctions registers, and simulate total FOB-to-CIF landed cost in seconds.
candidate_headlines.rationale: Directly tackles the two greatest pain points in cross-border trade: regulatory clearance and counterparty fraud risk.

candidate_headlines.h1_jsx:
The Operating System for
Cross-Border Commerce.
candidate_headlines.sub_copy: Search any commodity, route, or customs regime. Vametra AI synthesizes official government registers, live tariff books, and international procurement tenders into executable trade decisions.
candidate_headlines.rationale: Enterprise-grade SaaS positioning that mirrors Stripe or Palantir for international physical supply chains.

candidate_headlines.h1_jsx:
Navigate Global Tariffs.
Command Every Corridor.
candidate_headlines.sub_copy: From Mundra to Rotterdam, eliminate duty surprises, claim RoDTEP & CEPA duty-free corridors, and negotiate with verified enterprise buyers backed by cited legal provenance.
candidate_headlines.rationale: Geographically vivid and action-heavy, resonating strongly with both Indian exporters and global logistics desks.

hero_composition_arrangement.anti_pattern_fixed: Eliminates the split 50/50 generic 'text left, globe right' box. The globe is elevated into an atmospheric centerpiece that nests dynamically with the search and typography.

desktop_layout.container: relative min-h-[92vh] flex flex-col justify-between pt-16 pb-12 overflow-hidden
desktop_layout.architecture: Layered cinematic command cockpit with 3 primary depth strata (Z-0 Backdrop Atmosphere & Orbital Rings, Z-1 Interactive 3D Globe with dynamic focal offset, Z-2 Floating Glass Command Interface, Headings, and Search Bar).
desktop_layout.positioning_detail: The 3D Globe sits slightly offset to the upper-center/right with an expanded height (640px) enveloped in a radial atmospheric mask, while the dramatic H1 and floating Glass Search Command Bar overlap its lower hemisphere with crystal glassmorphism (`backdrop-blur-2xl bg-[#0a0f24]/75 border border-cyan-400/20 shadow-[0_20px_50px_rgba(0,194,255,0.15)]`).
depth_treatments: Vignette: radial gradient vignette (#050816 0% center alpha 0, blending to 85% solid #050816 at screen perimeter)
Aurora Bleed: Dual pulsing focal lights (cyan at 15% opacity at (25%, 20%) and violet at 20% opacity at (80%, 40%))
Orbital Tech Rings: 2 concentric subtle SVG orbital lines with dashed stroke animations framing the rotating globe
Floating Telemetry Badges: 2 floating telemetry status chips ('Real-time · Live trade lanes' and 'Compliance · DGFT · CBAM · FTA') locked in orbital 3D parallax

mobile_layout.globe_treatment: On mobile screens (< 768px), the globe is rendered in a compact dedicated container (`height={320}`) positioned as an ambient illuminated globe underneath the hero search bar with `pointer-events-none` so it doesn't hijack vertical scrolling or swipe gestures.
mobile_layout.typography: H1 scales strictly to `text-4xl font-extrabold leading-[1.08] tracking-tight` (ceiling respected, no overflow).
mobile_layout.search_bar: Search bar goes full-width with 44px min tap targets, clear ask button, suggestion pills in horizontal flex-nowrap with smooth snap scroll (`overflow-x-auto no-scrollbar pb-1`), ensuring zero visual collision.

scroll_driven_motion_system.engine: framer-motion (useScroll, useTransform, useSpring) + hardware-accelerated CSS transforms
performance_rules: Strictly animate GPU properties: transform (translateY, scale, rotate) and opacity.
Zero layout-thrashing: no per-frame DOM clientWidth/clientHeight reads during scroll.
Use will-change: transform on heavily animated hero globe and card containers.

global_scroll_progress.component: Top horizontal laser progress beam (1.5px cyan/violet line with blur glow pinned to z-50)

hero_section.globe_parallax: useTransform(scrollYProgress, [0, 0.25], [0, 90]) - globe gently descends on scroll down, giving three-dimensional depth
hero_section.floating_chips: Opposing parallax shifts: Top chip moves -35px on scroll, Bottom chip moves +30px

marquee_strip.velocity_effect: Dynamic CSS/transform acceleration: base marquee runs at 35s, with continuous scroll tracking.

features_bento.entrance: Staggered scroll-reveal using framer-motion whileInView={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 40 }} viewport={{ once: true, margin: '-80px' }} transition={{ duration: 0.7, ease: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] }}
features_bento.card_hover: Subtle 3D tilt + cyan border shimmer with -translate-y-1.5

command_center_flagship.pinned_reveal: Large spotlight scale transition: from scale(0.96) to scale(1.0) with deep obsidian glow as the card hits viewport center
command_center_flagship.floating_glow: Radial cyan emitter expanding from opacity 0.15 to 0.35 on scroll entry

verified_buyers_block.entrance: Slide-in split parallax: Left copy drifts gently from left (-20px to 0) while right metrics grid drifts from right (+20px to 0) with crisp opacity transition.

india_features_grid.stagger_reveal: Sequential stagger (0.08s per card) on scroll into view with glowing gold/cyan gradient border highlights.

photo_story_scrollytelling.parallax_tiles: Left tall image pans with useTransform(scrollYProgress, [0.65, 0.95], [-25, 25]), right dual images shift inversely, simulating drone cinematography over port terminals.

prefers_reduced_motion.strategy: CSS @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) and motion/react hook `useReducedMotion()`. When active, all parallax transforms collapse to 0, transitions become instant opacity crossfades, and marquee continues at a tranquil static display.

mobile_blueprint_390px.navigation_space: pt-20 to clear fixed glass header without overlap

globe_adaptation.touch_isolation: pointer-events-none touch-none so users can swipe page vertically without globe canvas intercepting touch gestures
globe_adaptation.position: Centered under search input with atmospheric radial mask cutting harsh bottom borders

typography_scale.stats: text-lg font-bold with text-[9px] uppercase tracking-wider labels

replace_or_upgrade.upgrade: Higher optical clarity with backdrop-saturate(180%) and backdrop-blur(24px) for Apple crystal clarity.
Add layered multi-point mesh gradients with subtle slow breathing animation for cinematic visual interest.
